item.description:
Connector 0.1.10

App build 65, Hype plugin 0.1.7 build 54.

  • New or updated JavaScript source appears immediately in Hype’s script editor and remains editable without reopening the document.
  • Read button action targets independently through element.get and element.list.
  • Rename scenes with the documented scene.rename operation. Scene lists now distinguish scene names from layout names.
  • Fix MCP resources/templates/list responses.
  • Update the scripting documentation and downloadable agent skill.

After updating Connector, save your work and restart Hype to load plugin build 54. Reconnect your MCP client and update your installed agent skill.
